{{short description|Dutch mathematician (born 1963)}}
[[File:Arno Kuijlaars.jpg|thumb|Kuijlaars at KU Leuven]]
'''Arnoldus Bernardus Jacobus Kuijlaars''' (born 1963) is a Dutch mathematician, specializing in [[approximation theory]].<ref>[https://perswww.kuleuven.be/~u0017946/ Arno Kuijlaars homepage at KU Leuven] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160105104031/https://perswww.kuleuven.be/~u0017946/ |date=January 5, 2016 }}</ref>

Kuijlaars completed his undergraduate studies at the [[Eindhoven University of Technology]] and received in 1991 his Ph.D. from [[Utrecht University]] with thesis ''Approximation of Metric Spaces with Applications in Potential Theory''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=53203|title=Arno B. J. Kuijlaars}}</ref> Currently he is a professor at the [[Katholieke Universiteit Leuven]].

In 1998 Kuijlaars won the triennially awarded Popov prize.<ref>[http://cio.nist.gov/esd/emaildir/lists/opsftalk/msg00029.html Arno Kuijlaars receives 1998 Popov prize] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303235157/http://cio.nist.gov/esd/emaildir/lists/opsftalk/msg00029.html |date=March 3, 2016 }}, Tom H. Koornwinder, 15 January 1998</ref> In 2010 he was an [[invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] at Hyderabad. In 2011 he was elected a corresponding member of the [[Koninklijke Nederlandse Akademie van Wetenschappen|KNAW]].<ref>[https://www.knaw.nl/nl/actueel/nieuws/nieuw-bestuur-en-nieuwe-leden-knaw Nieuw bestuur en nieuwe leden KNAW] Nieuws KNAW 17 May 2011</ref><ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/correspondents/11675?set_language=en |title=Arno Kuijlaars |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |access-date=23 November 2015}}</ref> In 2013 he was elected a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]].
